<summary>
Task overview: Build supply-side potential-GDP model for Georgia in /root/test-supply.xlsx (sheets: Production, Investment, CFC data, PWT, WEO_Data), using Excel formulas only. Steps: (1) collect PWT rnna, ECB CFC, IMF WEO GDP; (2) HP filter LnZ with Solver; (3) production-function projections including a 6.5B USD, 8-yr investment shock starting 2026.

Progress in Turns 1–15:
- Located workbook at /root/test-supply.xlsx; skill script at /skills/xlsx/recalc.py.
- Inspected all sheets:
  - Production sheet is a scaffold. B2=0.35 (capital share). B3 empty (needs avg depreciation formula). Years column C6:C27 = 2002–2023 (HP filter block); C36:C75 = 2002–2041 (production block). Column headers set for D5:E5 (K, Real GDP), F5:G5 (LnK, LnY), K5:O5 (LnZ, LnZ_HP, 2nd-order diff, LnA-Trend check, objective). Second block row 35 headers: K/Y, K, Y, LnZ trend, Ystar_base, Investment, ΔK, K_With, Ystar_with, Uplift, Projected GDP, Projected/Baseline growth.
  - Investment sheet: B1:C9 contains years 2026–2033 and deflated project investment values (648.59 … 352.61). Total ≈ ~10.58, but presumably deflated USD MM (already provided; agent does not need to construct).
  - CFC data sheet: A1:E29, years 1996–2023 in col B, column C for CFC needs to be filled from ECB, D for Capital Stock (link from PWT), E for depreciation rate (=C/D).
  - PWT sheet: years 1990–2023 in A2:A35, header B1='rnna' — needs values.
  - WEO_Data sheet: A large mostly-empty scaffold. Rows 8–51 give years 2000–2043 in column B. C and D need real GDP level (NGDP_R, billions national currency) and growth (NGDP_RPCH). Metadata rows 1–7 already contain WEO subject codes; base year 2019; latest actual 2024. Note: the file already contains embedded IMF WEO data further down (rows 16392–16419 etc., replicated many times) showing values for Georgia 2000–2027 (e.g., 2000 GDP=16.963 growth=1.865, ... 2025 GDP=71.54 growth=5.977, 2026=75.117 growth=5, 2027=78.873 growth=5). Agent can reuse these numbers when populating the top block (or link them), and extend growth of 5% through 2043.
- Created task_tracker plan with 7 items (STEP1a in progress).
- Network limitations: no curl/wget; urllib works but PWT xlsx download attempts failed:
  - www.rug.nl/ggdc/docs/pwt1001.xlsx → 404
  - dataverse.nl datafile 354095 → returned Anubis anti-bot HTML page (7405 bytes), not the file.
  - Several GitHub mirror URLs → 404.
  - DBnomics: found GGDC provider has dataset code "penn10" (Penn World Table 10.0). Direct dataset info endpoint returned empty dimensions, but the dataset exists and should be queryable via /v22/series/GGDC/penn10/... — not yet queried successfully.
- No Playwright or MCP tools available in environment (which which showed nothing); only terminal + task_tracker are being used.

Open issues to resolve next:
- Fetch PWT rnna (capital stock, national-currency 2017 prices) for Georgia 1990–2023, likely via DBnomics penn10 series GEO.rnna.
- Fetch ECB CFC annual series IDCM.A.N.GE.W2.S1.S1.D.P51C.N1G._T._Z.XDC.V.N.
- Populate WEO_Data rows 8–51 with GDP level and growth, plus formulas for years 2028–2043 extending 2027 growth (5%) and computing GDP level.
- Then link data into CFC data (D from PWT, E = C/D), Production sheet cells.
- Build HP filter columns and set up Solver.
- Build production-function projection table with ΔK/K_With uplift.

No terminal "task infeasible" signals from agent yet. Agent has been methodical but is stuck on PWT source access.
</summary>
